title: Combining Tanzania and Kenya in One Trip
excerpt: Combining Tanzania and Kenya in one trip: border crossings, routes and when it makes sense.
body:
## Why combine

- The Masai Mara and the Serengeti together.
- Amboseli views of Kilimanjaro.
- Variety.

## Routes

- By road via the Namanga border between Arusha and Nairobi.
- By flight between Kilimanjaro and Nairobi.

## Visas

Check the visa requirements for both countries, and whether you need a multiple-entry visa for Tanzania. East African visa options exist for some countries but not all.

## Logistics

Vehicles usually change at the border.

## Our advice

For most first-time visitors, Tanzania alone offers enough. For a second trip, combining can be great.

[Plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
